roles.drugs: Severe agitation or psychosis only (routine antipsychotic use not recommended): low-dose haloperidol as needed
Older patients: 2nd-generation antipsychotics (risperidone, olanzapine, quetiapine) may be preferred (fewer extrapyramidal effects); given orally
Alcohol or benzodiazepine withdrawal delirium only: IV benzodiazepines are the drugs of choice. Avoid benzodiazepines for every other cause of delirium
